issue.title: Bug: `show ip route <protocol> json` produces invalid JSON output

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

I was trying to write a Python script to auto-parse json outputs of commands. However, commands like `show ip route bgp json` produce invalid JSON with a prefix, making the output unparseable.

The `: ` prefix breaks JSON parsing. This affects all protocol filters: bgp, static, connected, ospf, etc.

For now I can use direct vtysh execution to work around it, but this probably should be fixed.

### Steps to Reproduce
```
admin@switch:~$ show ip route bgp json | head
: {
  "<IP>/0":[
    {
      "prefix":"<IP>/0",
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior
```
admin@switch:~$ docker exec bgp vtysh -c 'show ip route bgp json' | head
{
  "<IP>/0":[
    {
      "prefix":"<IP>/0",
```

resolution.title: Fix invalid JSON output for 'show ip route <protocol> json' commands
resolution.description:
#### What I did
Fixed `show ip route <protocol> json` commands producing invalid JSON output with namespace prefix.

Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/24398
Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/issues/3687

#### How I did it

The root cause is `show/bgp_common.py` have a special if clause for protocol filters (bgp, static, etc.), triggering namespace-prefix output path even when JSON is requested.

[Current logic:](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/blob/3994fcdee03cd6f8752f8b22e541ba13c778dc2c/show/bgp_common.py#L405-L409)
```python3
if found_other_parms:
    print("{}:".format(ns))   # Prints ': ' on single-ASIC (ns='')
    print(output)
    continue                  # Skips JSON processing
```

[Solution:](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/blob/e8debf2cd9d2b53b74303d621303b0c3d57fb312/show/bgp_common.py#L405-L409)

```python3
if found_other_parms and not found_json:
    print("{}:".format(ns))
    print(output)
    continue
```

We simply skip namespace-prefix path when JSON output is requested.
This allows JSON requests to fall through to [proper JSON processing later at line 413](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/blob/3994fcdee03cd6f8752f8b22e541ba13c778dc2c/show/bgp_common.py#L432-L433).

#### How to verify it
Test protocol-filtered route commands with JSON output:
```
show ip route bgp json
show ip route static json
show ip route connected json
```

Verify output starts with `{` and is valid JSON (parseable with `jq` or `python -m json.tool`).

Verify non-JSON commands still work:
```
show ip route bgp
show ip route
```

#### Previous command output (if the output of a command-line utility has changed)
```bash
admin@switch:~$ show ip route bgp json | head
: {
  "<IP>/0":[
    {
      "prefix":"<IP>/0",
      "prefixLen":0,
      "protocol":"bgp",
      "vrfId":0,
      "vrfName":"default",
      "selected":true,
```

#### New command output (if the output of a command-line utility has changed)
```bash
admin@switch:~$ show ip route bgp json | head
{
  "<IP>/0":[
    {
      "prefix":"<IP>/0",
      "prefixLen":0,
      "protocol":"bgp",
      "vrfId":0,
      "vrfName":"default",
      "selected":true,
      "destSelected":true,
```
